hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member A_i is recovered as A_i = O_i[F], where O_G0002 substitutes z -> x, O_G0003 substitutes z -> y, and O_G0001 is the first divided difference of F over nodes x, y.
required_assumptions: polygamma(0, x) and polygamma(0, y) are defined

proof_obligations.expected: G0002 == F(z) with z substituted by x
G0003 == F(z) with z substituted by y

hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three catalog expressions are structurally generated by a single latent function F(z) = polygamma(0,z). G0002 and G0003 are evaluations of F at the two nodes x and y, while G0001 is the first-order divided difference of F over those nodes, matching the explicit expression.
